images.use: Assembled homepage hero; camera right, live headline left
images.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: cinematic homepage art-direction reference, widescreen 16:9, one image.
Primary request: A breathtaking precision-product launch photograph of the exact CAMID B1 fully mechanical instant camera.
Input images: Image 1 is the MATERIAL, FINISH, LOGO PANEL AND LIGHTING reference. Image 2 is the authoritative PRODUCT GEOMETRY/IDENTITY reference. Preserve the exact tall stepped rectangular body, wide upper film-outlet housing with long slit, central lower lens with red surround integrated into its square housing, actual side lever/handle placement and overall proportions of image 2. Do not redesign or add parts.
Scene/backdrop: very dark charcoal studio, deep wine-red halo behind the camera tapering to black, subtle low black floor.
Composition: camera fills the right 58 percent of a 16:9 frame, suspended with its lower edge just above the floor, a controlled 18 degree diagonal tilt, front three-quarter view exposing the CAMID side panel and lens; left 38 percent is quiet near-black negative space for future live HTML headlines. Entire assembled camera in frame, generous breathing room.
Lighting: premium macro product advertising, a large narrow neutral-white softbox highlight precisely following the lens rim and rounded panel edges, a deep crimson rear rim, restrained cool neutral fill. Deliberate black shadows with visible material detail, rich depth, crisp geometry. No excessive fog.
Materials: match image 1: charcoal micrograin polymer shell (not bright plastic); bounded darker graphite bead-blasted rectangular signature panel; crimson anodized/brushed metal lens surround and operation accents; neutral clear optical glass with crisp white reflection and visible depth, no green tint; steel where visible. Logo is the existing exact text "CAMID", tone-on-tone deep dark red matte print on the graphite panel, subtle tactile finish, no bright neon, no raised chrome letters. Product identity must stay intact.
Style: photorealistic luxury precision equipment campaign, tactile physically plausible materials, strong but carefully limited crimson accents.
Constraints: exactly one assembled camera, no camera redesign, no extra lens, no film photo, no people, no UI, no added title/caption, no particles, no sci-fi holograms, no fake branding, no watermark.
